workflow_responses.schema_proposal:
Absolutely! Below is a specific JSON schema structure that incorporates all the enhancements we've discussed, along with how your existing data would map to this new schema.

### Proposed New Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "expense": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "cost": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "category": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["Food & Drink", "Groceries", "Transportation", "Subscriptions", "Healthcare", "Miscellaneous"]
    },
    "subcategory": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["Coffee", "Lunch", "Dinner", "Grocery", "Gas", "Streaming", "Pharmacy", "Other"]
    },
    "date": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date"
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "is_recurring": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "USD"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "expense",
    "cost",
    "category",
    "date",
    "payment_method"
  ]
}
```
